en.name: Orbit Switch
en.title: Orbit Switch (preview)
en.desc: Tap to jump between the inner and outer orbit. Survive 90 seconds.
en.shareText: {streak} dodges in a row in Orbit Switch. Same orbit, can you beat me? → {url}

en.startDesktop: Space / Click to switch inner ↔ outer orbit

zh-hans.name: 轨道切换
